units.title: Why We Eat
units.description: Understanding that food gives us energy to play, study, and grow.
steps: Recall how you feel when you are very hungry.
Identify that food is like fuel for a car.
Realize that different foods help our body in different ways.

units.title: Where Food Comes From
units.description: Basic introduction to plant and animal sources.
steps: Look at a fruit and identify the tree it came from.
Identify milk as coming from cows or goats.
Understand that all our food comes from nature.
